name: ASUS router (AiMesh)
author: Netlens
description: Reads which device is connected to which AiMesh node (stock ASUSWRT, tested on an RT-AX92U) for the hierarchy and the map, the router's Traffic Analyzer (traffic per application and per device) and the speed of its own interfaces: internet (WAN), wired LAN and Wi-Fi radios. Read-only, never SSH: one login, a few reads and a logout per sync. A refused login pauses automatic syncing so the router does not lock the account.

config.label: Router address
config.help: The router's web interface. HTTPS defaults to port 8443.

config.label: Verify TLS certificate
config.help: Leave off: ASUS routers use a self-signed certificate.

config.label: Read the Traffic Analyzer statistics
config.help: Needs Traffic Analyzer switched on in the router (Adaptive QoS > Traffic Analyzer > Statistic). The first figures appear about an hour after switching it on.

config.label: Record the speed of the router's interfaces
config.help: The internet connection (WAN), the wired LAN and the Wi-Fi radios, as graphs of bits per second. One extra read per sync; nothing to switch on in the router.
